==My Wheel of Time Status==
I began reading the ''[[Wheel of Time]]'' series in January of 2011 and finished through ''[[Towers of Midnight]]'' in early October. Around Christmas I finished reading ''[[New Spring]]'', so I have currently read all of the books (not including ''[[The World of Robert Jordan's the Wheel of Time]]'') in the series. I currently own ''New Spring'', ''[[Lord of Chaos]]'', ''[[Crossroads of Twilight]]'', ''[[Knife of Dreams]]'' and ''Towers of Midnight''.  However, of of those books, only ''New Spring'' and ''Towers of Midnight'' are readily available. If I made changes to articles don't pertain to either of these books then I probably used Leigh Butler's chapter summaries or Encyclopedia WOT.
